corrections.caveats: Enricher: the summation order is unchanged, so the output is bit-identical to the original. The mechanism (Rust emits no type-based alias information here, so a store into the output may alias the Vec headers and forces a load-add-store each step) is inferred from code only; the repo has no assembly or profile. The safe version still bounds-checks a[i][k], b[k] and b[k][j]. The repo bench cannot run this pair without editing the pub use alias in lib.rs. The Criterion closure clones the inputs (about 202 allocations, 80 KB) and allocates and drops the output (101 allocations) inside the timed loop; the cost is fixed, so ratios are diluted, not inflated. No results, CPU or rustc version in the repo; unmerged Dependabot PR #2.
